en.title: Professional proformas from your Android phone
en.intro: Prepare, save and share proforma invoices in English or Amharic. After company activation, create documents offline.
features: English and Amharic interface and PDF labels
Customer records and a reusable item catalogue
Common units, VAT and amounts with two decimal places
Grand totals in digits and words
Your company logo and optional PNG stamp
Optional terms you write or leave blank
en.priceNote: Activation is bound to a device. A second company needs a separate activation. Contact support before changing phones or reinstalling. Internet is required for account access, payment submission and activation.
steps: Download the APK from this page and install it on your Android phone. Allow installation from your browser only when Android requests it.
Open the app. Choose EN or አማ and register your account using your phone number and a password of at least six digits.
Check the payment instructions shown inside the app. Pay ETB 1,000 through Telebirr to 0911099246. Confirm that the recipient is Thomas Abate before paying.
Return to the app. Enter the payer's phone number and transaction reference / FT number. You may attach a JPG or PNG receipt. Submit for verification.
After approval, refresh your status and complete your company profile with its legal name, TIN, logo and VAT confirmation.
Once activation succeeds, add customers and items, prepare proformas and export PDFs. Keep regular business-data backups.
en.safety: Payment approval requires verification. Do not pay again because a request is pending or a connection failed; refresh and contact support. Approval time varies. Confirm the current fee in the app before paying.
en.demoNote: Screenshots show the actual app components in a browser preview with fictional sample records. Android appearance may vary. Samples are demonstrations, not real offers or tax invoices.
en.support: For installation, payment or activation assistance, call 0911099246 or 0947833314. Never share your password or authenticator code. Send payment details privately, not in public comments or channels.
en.channelNote: The WhatsApp link opens a broadcast channel for updates, not a private support conversation.
en.backup: Your business records are stored on your phone. They are not automatically synchronized to the server. Export a backup to a safe location before updating or changing phones. Restoring a backup does not activate another device.
faq: This release is for Android only. The APK does not install on iPhone.
Can I use it without internet?
Yes, after successful activation, proforma preparation and PDF generation work offline. Online account, payment and recovery actions still need a connection.
Install a compatible update over the existing app. Do not uninstall first. Export a backup before updating.
Is this a tax invoice app?
It prepares proforma invoices. A proforma is not a tax invoice. Confirm the appropriate VAT rate and document requirements for your business.
en.footer: Developed by Rayz Technology plc · Rayz Proforma · Android release 2.0.9
en.guideIntro: A practical guide to installation, activation and everyday proforma preparation. Follow the numbered steps and keep a backup of your business records.

guidePages.title: Install and create your account
steps: Download the signed APK only from the official download page. This release is for Android, not iPhone.
Open the downloaded file. If prompted, allow installation from that browser or file app. Keep Play Protect enabled. You can remove the installation permission afterwards.
Open Rayz Proforma and select EN or አማ. Choose New account? Register. Enter your own phone number, including country code, and a numeric password of at least six digits.
Choose a longer, hard-to-guess password. Avoid 123456, repeated digits and your phone number. Phone verification by SMS is not enabled.
If you already have an account, sign in instead of creating another. Before updating an existing installation, export a backup and install over the existing app without uninstalling.
guidePages.note: Do not share your password. Support does not need it to verify a payment.

guidePages.title: Pay and request activation
steps: Sign in and read the current fee, recipient and instructions inside the app. The launch offer is ETB 1,000 per company.
In Telebirr, pay 0911099246 and confirm that the displayed recipient is Thomas Abate before completing payment.
Return to the app and scroll to Submit payment for a company. Enter the payer's phone number and the exact transaction reference / FT number.
You may attach a genuine JPG or PNG receipt up to 5 MB. A screenshot alone does not prove payment. Submit the details for verification.
Use Refresh status to check the decision. If rejected, read the reason and correct the submission. If approved, continue to company registration. Approval time varies; call support if needed.
guidePages.note: A pending request or service error is not a reason to pay again. Keep your transaction reference and contact support.

guidePages.title: Complete your company profile
steps: After approval, refresh your status and open company registration. Enter the correct legal business name and TIN.
Select your company logo as JPG or PNG. The activation profile requires a logo.
Optionally attach your organization's PNG stamp. A transparent background works best. It appears near the bottom of new proformas.
Scroll down to review the currency, VAT rate, validity, numbering prefix and optional contact or bank details. Confirm the VAT rate appropriate to your business.
Write optional payment, delivery and Terms & Conditions text, or leave optional terms blank. Save the profile to finish device-bound activation.
guidePages.note: If activation fails, keep your entered details and retry. Do not buy another activation for the same failed request. Legal identity changes and device transfers may require administrator approval.

guidePages.title: Create customers and a proforma
steps: From your workspace, open Customers and add the customer's name and any optional TIN or contact details.
Add frequently quoted products to Catalogue, including descriptions, units and prices. You can also type items while composing a document.
Choose Create proforma. Select the customer, review dates and currency, then add line descriptions, quantities and unit prices.
Select common units such as pcs, c/n, m, m², kg or g. Review VAT and the calculated totals. Monetary amounts display with grouping and two decimal places.
Scroll to the optional notes and terms. Edit or clear them for this document. Save the draft and review it before issuing.
guidePages.note: VAT is a configurable input. The app's initial value is not tax advice. Customer records, items and documents stay on this phone unless you export them.

guidePages.title: Issue and share your PDF
steps: Open the saved draft in Document preview. Check the company, customer, line items, dates, currency, totals and any terms.
Choose EN or አማ before generating the PDF. Labels and totals in words follow that language; text you entered is not automatically translated.
Choose Issue proforma when ready. A final number is allocated and the issued document becomes read-only.
Use PDF preview, Export PDF, Share PDF or Print PDF. In the Android system sheet, choose a destination, messaging app or printer.
To reuse an issued document, choose Duplicate as a new draft. Correct the new draft rather than trying to overwrite issued history.
guidePages.note: The PDF includes a logo, an optional stamp and only the terms you supplied. It is a proforma, not a tax invoice. The sample PDFs in this pack use fictional data.

guidePages.title: Back up and restore business data
steps: Open Settings & backup and choose the business-data export action.
Save the ZIP in a safe location outside the app, such as storage you control. Check that the file exists and keep more than one recent copy.
Export a fresh backup before installing updates, replacing a phone, clearing app data or uninstalling.
To restore, select the backup ZIP and follow the prompts. Restore replaces ALL current local data, so export a fresh backup first. Use a Rayz Proforma backup, not an arbitrary ZIP file.
A backup preserves business records and supported images, including the optional stamp. It does not transfer a licence or activate another device. Contact support for device recovery or transfer.
guidePages.note: There is no automatic cloud synchronization of your invoices. Protect backup files because they contain business and customer information.

guidePages.title: Change your account password
steps: Connect to the internet, open Activation / account and sign in if needed.
Choose Change password. Enter your current password.
Enter a new numeric password of at least six digits, then enter it again in Confirm new password. Longer numeric passwords are supported, up to 72 digits.
Use Show or Hide to check your typing privately. Masking dots hide the characters; the app never displays the stored password hash.

Choose Update password. On success, other account sessions are signed out while the current session remains. If you forgot the current password, contact support; do not send your password in a message.
guidePages.note: Use a unique, hard-to-guess password. If the service is unavailable, retry when connected. An account password change is an online action.

guidePages.title: Offline work and getting help
steps: After successful activation, create and save proformas and generate PDFs offline on the activated phone.
A failed status refresh does not by itself remove a valid local licence. Account access, payment checks, first activation and licence recovery need internet.
If a service error appears during registration, keep the entered company details, retry, and avoid paying again. If it persists, record the technical request reference.
For support, call 0911099246 or 0947833314. Share the app version, Android version, action that failed, time of failure and a redacted screenshot.
Follow the official Facebook, Telegram and WhatsApp channels linked from the download page. Never post passwords, receipt details, private keys or customer records publicly.
guidePages.note: Only authorized support should arrange device transfer. Keep the old app and its data until your backup and recovery plan are confirmed.

መለያ ካለዎት አዲስ ከመፍጠር ይልቅ ይግቡ። ለማዘመን ምትኬ ያውጡ፤ የቀድሞውን ሳያራግፉ አዲሱን በላዩ ላይ ይጫኑ።
guidePages.note: የይለፍ ቃልዎን አያጋሩ። ክፍያ ለማረጋገጥ ድጋፍ ሰጪው የይለፍ ቃልዎን አይፈልግም።

guidePages.title: ይክፈሉ እና ማግበር ይጠይቁ
steps: ይግቡና በመተግበሪያው ያለውን ወቅታዊ ክፍያ፣ ተቀባይ እና መመሪያ ያንብቡ። የመነሻ ዋጋው ለእያንዳንዱ ድርጅት 1,000 ብር ነው።
በቴሌብር ወደ 0911099246 ይክፈሉ። ከማጠናቀቅዎ በፊት የተቀባዩ ስም Thomas Abate መሆኑን ያረጋግጡ።
ወደ መተግበሪያው ይመለሱና ወደ ክፍያ ማስገቢያው ይውረዱ። የከፋዩን ስልክ እና ትክክለኛውን የግብይት ማጣቀሻ / FT ቁጥር ያስገቡ።
እስከ 5 MB የሆነ እውነተኛ JPG ወይም PNG ደረሰኝ ማያያዝ ይችላሉ። ምስል ብቻ ክፍያን አያረጋግጥም። መረጃውን ለማረጋገጥ ይላኩ።
ውሳኔውን ለማየት ሁኔታዎን ያድሱ። ካልጸደቀ ምክንያቱን ያንብቡና ያስተካክሉ። ሲጸድቅ ወደ ድርጅት ምዝገባ ይቀጥሉ። የማጽደቅ ጊዜ ይለያያል።
guidePages.note: ጥያቄዎ በመጠባበቅ ላይ መሆኑ ወይም የአገልግሎት ስህተት እንደገና ለመክፈል ምክንያት አይደለም። የግብይት ማጣቀሻዎን ያስቀምጡና ድጋፍ ያግኙ።

guidePages.title: የድርጅትዎን መረጃ ያጠናቅቁ
steps: ክፍያው ከጸደቀ በኋላ ሁኔታዎን ያድሱና የድርጅት ምዝገባ ይክፈቱ። ትክክለኛውን ህጋዊ የንግድ ስም እና TIN ያስገቡ።
የድርጅትዎን አርማ በJPG ወይም PNG ይምረጡ። ለማግበሪያ መረጃው አርማ ያስፈልጋል።
ከፈለጉ የድርጅትዎን PNG ማህተም ያያይዙ። ግልጽ ጀርባ ያለው ይመረጣል። በአዲስ ፕሮፎርማዎች የታችኛው ክፍል ይታያል።
ወደ ታች ይውረዱ። ምንዛሬ፣ ቫት፣ የሚቆይበት ጊዜ፣ የቁጥር ቅድመ ቅጥያ እና አማራጭ የእውቂያ ወይም የባንክ መረጃን ያረጋግጡ። ተገቢውን የቫት መጠን ያረጋግጡ።
አማራጭ የክፍያ፣ የአቅርቦት እና ሌሎች ውሎችን ይጻፉ ወይም ባዶ ይተዉ። ከመሣሪያው ጋር የተያያዘውን ማግበር ለማጠናቀቅ ያስቀምጡ።
guidePages.note: ማግበሩ ካልተሳካ ያስገቡትን መረጃ ያቆዩና እንደገና ይሞክሩ። ለተመሳሳይ ጥያቄ እንደገና አይግዙ። የህጋዊ ማንነት ለውጥ እና የመሣሪያ ዝውውር የአስተዳዳሪ ፈቃድ ሊፈልጉ ይችላሉ።

guidePages.title: ደንበኛ ይጨምሩ እና ፕሮፎርማ ያዘጋጁ
steps: ከሥራ ቦታዎ ወደ ደንበኞች ይግቡ። የደንበኛውን ስም እና ካስፈለገ የTIN ወይም የእውቂያ መረጃ ያስገቡ።
ተደጋጋሚ ዕቃዎችን ከመግለጫ፣ መለኪያ እና ዋጋ ጋር በካታሎግ ያስቀምጡ። ሰነዱን ሲያዘጋጁም በቀጥታ ማስገባት ይችላሉ።
ፕሮፎርማ ፍጠር ይምረጡ። ደንበኛውን ይምረጡ፣ ቀኖችን እና ምንዛሬን ያረጋግጡ። የዕቃ መግለጫ፣ ብዛት እና የአንዱን ዋጋ ይጨምሩ።
እንደ pcs፣ c/n፣ m፣ m²፣ kg ወይም g ያሉ መለኪያዎችን ይምረጡ። ቫትን እና የተሰላውን ድምር ያረጋግጡ። የገንዘብ መጠኖች በሺህ መለያ እና በሁለት የአስርዮሽ ቦታ ይታያሉ።
ወደ አማራጭ ማስታወሻዎች እና ውሎች ይውረዱ። ለዚህ ሰነድ ያስተካክሉ ወይም ያጽዱ። ረቂቁን ያስቀምጡና ከማውጣትዎ በፊት ይገምግሙ።
guidePages.note: ቫት ሊቀየር የሚችል ግቤት ነው። የመነሻው መጠን የታክስ ምክር አይደለም። ደንበኞች፣ ዕቃዎች እና ሰነዶች እርስዎ ካላወጡዋቸው በስተቀር በስልኩ ላይ ይቀመጣሉ።

guidePages.title: PDF ያውጡ እና ያጋሩ
steps: የተቀመጠውን ረቂቅ በሰነድ ቅድመ እይታ ይክፈቱ። ድርጅቱን፣ ደንበኛውን፣ ዕቃዎችን፣ ቀኖችን፣ ምንዛሬን፣ ድምርን እና ውሎችን ያረጋግጡ።
PDF ከማውጣትዎ በፊት EN ወይም አማ ይምረጡ። መለያዎች እና በፊደል ያለው ድምር በዚያ ቋንቋ ይወጣሉ። እርስዎ የጻፉት ጽሑፍ በራሱ አይተረጎምም።
ዝግጁ ሲሆኑ ፕሮፎርማ አውጣ ይምረጡ። የመጨረሻ ቁጥር ይመደባል፣ ሰነዱም ለንባብ ብቻ ይሆናል።
የPDF ቅድመ እይታ፣ PDF አውጣ፣ PDF አጋራ ወይም PDF አትም ይጠቀሙ። በአንድሮይድ መስኮት የማስቀመጫ ቦታ፣ የመልዕክት መተግበሪያ ወይም አታሚ ይምረጡ።
የወጣውን ሰነድ እንደገና ለመጠቀም እንደ አዲስ ረቂቅ ቅዳ ይምረጡ። የቀድሞውን ታሪክ ከመቀየር ይልቅ አዲሱን ረቂቅ ያስተካክሉ።
guidePages.note: PDFው አርማ፣ አማራጭ ማህተም እና እርስዎ የጻፉትን ውሎች ብቻ ይይዛል። ፕሮፎርማ ነው፤ የታክስ ደረሰኝ አይደለም። በዚህ ጥቅል ያሉ ናሙናዎች ልቦለድ መረጃ ይጠቀማሉ።

guidePages.title: ምትኬ ያውጡ እና ይመልሱ
steps: ቅንብሮች እና ምትኬ ይክፈቱ። የንግድ መረጃ ምትኬ ማውጫን ይምረጡ።
የZIP ፋይሉን ከመተግበሪያው ውጭ በሚቆጣጠሩት ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ቦታ ያስቀምጡ። ፋይሉ መኖሩን ያረጋግጡ፤ ከአንድ በላይ ቅርብ ጊዜ የወጣ ቅጂ ያስቀምጡ።
ከማዘመን፣ ስልክ ከመቀየር፣ የመተግበሪያ መረጃ ከማጽዳት ወይም ከማራገፍ በፊት አዲስ ምትኬ ያውጡ።
ለመመለስ የምትኬ ZIP ይምረጡና መመሪያውን ይከተሉ። መመለስ ያለውን ሁሉንም የአካባቢ መረጃ ይተካል፤ ስለዚህ መጀመሪያ አዲስ ምትኬ ያውጡ። የRayz Proforma ምትኬ ብቻ ይጠቀሙ።
ምትኬው የንግድ መዝገቦችን እና እንደ ማህተም ያሉ የተደገፉ ምስሎችን ይይዛል። ፈቃድ አያዛውርም፣ ሌላ መሣሪያም አያገብርም። ለመሣሪያ መመለስ ወይም ዝውውር ድጋፍ ያግኙ።
guidePages.note: ደረሰኞችዎ በራስ ሰር ከደመና ጋር አይመሳሰሉም። ምትኬዎች የድርጅት እና የደንበኛ መረጃ ስለሚይዙ በደህና ይጠብቋቸው።

guidePages.title: የመለያ የይለፍ ቃል ይቀይሩ
steps: ከኢንተርኔት ጋር ይገናኙ። ማግበሪያ / መለያ ይክፈቱና ካስፈለገ ይግቡ።
የይለፍ ቃል ቀይር ይምረጡ። አሁን ያለውን የይለፍ ቃል ያስገቡ።
ቢያንስ ስድስት አሃዝ ያለውን አዲስ የይለፍ ቃል ያስገቡ። በማረጋገጫው መስክ እንደገና ይጻፉት። እስከ 72 አሃዝ ያሉ ረዥም ቁጥሮችን ይደግፋል።
ያሳዩ ወይም ይደብቁ በማለት በግል ያረጋግጡ። ነጥቦቹ የጻፉትን ለመደበቅ ናቸው፤ የተቀመጠው የይለፍ ቃል ሃሽ አይታይም።
የይለፍ ቃል አዘምን ይምረጡ። ሲሳካ ሌሎች የመለያ ክፍለ ጊዜዎች ይወጣሉ፣ ያሉበት ግን ይቀጥላል። የአሁኑን ከረሱ ድጋፍ ያግኙ፤ የይለፍ ቃልዎን በመልዕክት አይላኩ።
guidePages.note: የተለየና ለመገመት አስቸጋሪ የይለፍ ቃል ይጠቀሙ። አገልግሎቱ ካልተገኘ ግንኙነት ሲኖር እንደገና ይሞክሩ። የመለያ የይለፍ ቃል ለውጥ ኢንተርኔት ይፈልጋል።

guidePages.title: ያለ ኢንተርኔት መሥራት እና ድጋፍ
steps: ማግበሩ ከተሳካ በኋላ በተገበረው ስልክ ላይ ፕሮፎርማ ይፍጠሩ፣ ያስቀምጡ እና PDF ያውጡ።
የሁኔታ ማደስ አለመሳካት ብቻውን ትክክለኛውን የአካባቢ ፈቃድ አያስወግድም። መለያ፣ ክፍያ፣ የመጀመሪያ ማግበር እና ፈቃድ መመለስ ኢንተርኔት ይፈልጋሉ።
በምዝገባ ጊዜ ስህተት ከታየ ያስገቡትን መረጃ ያቆዩ፣ እንደገና ይሞክሩ እና ድጋሚ አይክፈሉ። ከቀጠለ የቴክኒክ ማጣቀሻ ቁጥሩን ይያዙ።
ለድጋፍ በ0911099246 ወይም 0947833314 ይደውሉ። የመተግበሪያውን ስሪት፣ የአንድሮይድ ስሪት፣ ያልተሳካውን ተግባር፣ ጊዜውን እና ሚስጥር የተደበቀበትን ማሳያ ያጋሩ።
ከማውረጃ ገጹ የተያያዙትን ይፋዊ የፌስቡክ፣ ቴሌግራም እና ዋትስአፕ ቻናሎች ይከተሉ። የይለፍ ቃል፣ የደረሰኝ መረጃ፣ የግል ቁልፍ ወይም የደንበኛ መረጃ በሕዝብ ፊት አይለጥፉ።
guidePages.note: የመሣሪያ ዝውውር በተፈቀደለት ድጋፍ ብቻ ይደረግ። ምትኬዎ እና የመመለሻ እቅድዎ እስኪረጋገጥ ድረስ የቀድሞውን መተግበሪያ እና መረጃ ያቆዩ።
